errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD-plus-descriptor-ML intervention does not reconstruct the target MTP/FEP free-energy methodology or its replacement of EAM-based thermodynamic integration.
CALPHAD is incorrectly characterized as generally assuming ideal mixing and neglecting non-ideal interactions; modern CALPHAD models explicitly parameterize excess Gibbs energies and ordered phases.
The cited oxidation and mechanical-property studies do not support the claimed melting-temperature accuracy, entropy corrections, or stated CALPHAD error magnitudes.
The asserted ±50 K melting-temperature and ±10% entropy-of-fusion accuracy has no training-set definition, validation protocol, or relevant evidence.
Heat-capacity prediction is requested but is not operationally addressed by the proposed model or falsification experiment.
